title: Chapter 82: First Kill Of A General
content:
Chapter 82: First Kill Of A General

The middle of the battlefield.

Gong Zheng has already started wrestling with Doliku, both of them are fighting fiercely, and both want to knock the other down.

Doliku has a huge level advantage, while Gong Zheng mainly adds strength. Although he is at a disadvantage, he will not lose for a while.

Now Wang Shuo and others must quickly clean up the horse bandits on the periphery.

As time goes by, the number of horse bandits begins to decrease rapidly.

Half an hour later, the few remaining horse bandits turned around and ran away!

Gong Zheng also fell into exhaustion and was directly pressed under his opponent.

Ayub replaced Gong Zheng and fought with Doliku in close combat.

Doliku, who was in a desperate situation, spit out a mouthful of blood and cursed: "Do you dare to fight with grandpa?"

He admitted that he was too reckless to fight ten people alone before.

Seeing that he could not leave alive, he wanted to choose a decent way to die.

"Okay, we will give you a quick death!" Wang Shuo also sympathized with him, the hero's end.

It was impossible to let him go, but before dying, he could still satisfy his opponent's wish for a duel.

The cavalry squad formed a circle and watched the final battle between Ayub and Doliku.

Because Doliku had been seriously injured before, and his physical strength was greatly consumed.

The battle with Ayub was at an absolute disadvantage from the beginning.

Ten minutes later, Doliku closed his eyes forever.

[Your subordinate Ayub killed the third in command of Feilong Village and a junior general, ID: Bandit 20014 Doliku. ]

[You led your cavalry squad and won a battle perfectly after a hard and arduous battle. Your command value +5. ]

[Your level was upgraded to level 13. ]

[Your "Dragon Spear Art" was upgraded to level 3, and you gained all attributes +1, command value +1, attack power +2]

[Your subordinates... have been upgraded. ]

A series of system prompts sounded, but none of them attracted much attention from Wang Shuo.

At this time, he saw that a purple scroll and two pieces of equipment fell next to Doriku's body.

After picking them up, he saw their basic information.

[Proof of military officer transfer: After using it, you can transfer to become a military officer. ]

[Long axe: gold quality, strength +50, attack +140, skill: fierce attack. Charge for 2 seconds, release 3 times of your own strength to attack, the first attack is more effective, CD: 10 minutes, durability 100/100. ]

[Chain mail: gold quality, constitution +50, defense +80, skill: iron wall. Release an absolute defense once, which can reduce the opponent's damage by 99.9%, CD: 30 minutes, durability 100/100. ]

Wang Shuo was so excited that he was speechless for a long time when he saw these three items.

This is definitely a little cow dancing - one is awesome on the left, and the other is awesome on the right.

But at this time, Wang Shuo was in a dilemma because his trusted general and his profession conflicted.

He wanted to keep such powerful equipment for himself, but reason told him that it was the best choice to transfer Ayub to a general and equip him with chain mail.

After thinking it over, he decided to put the equipment away first and wait for later.

After cleaning the battlefield, he got more than 120 energy crystals and 2 soul crystals.

These 2 soul crystals were naturally exploded by Doliku, and he also exploded 50 energy crystals.

This made Wang Shuo feel a little surprised. It turned out that each life did not necessarily have only 1 soul crystal.

In addition to this, there are many excellent equipments. Gong Zheng and others handed them all to Wang Shuo.

"I can't see that you can actually defeat a junior general." Dongfang Ling slowly walked to Wang Shuo's side and said with a smile, "I thought I needed to take action!"
